label: president or manager of
definition: Argument 1 holds or formerly held the office of president or manager of organization 2.
scope_notes: The two dominant title families are president and manager, as in the prior evaluation. Generic executive, director, owner, coach or political leader alone does not establish either title.

The paths say Democratic leader; neither a president nor a manager office is specified, and the second argument is a party adjective.
